name: @activepieces/piece-kustomer
description: Create and manage Kustomer customers, conversations, and custom objects.

auth.description:
Authenticate using a Kustomer API token.

Paste a private Kustomer API token with access to customers, conversations, and KObjects.

create-customer.name: create-customer
create-customer.description: Creates a new customer record in Kustomer.

email.description: Primary email address of the customer.

phone.description: Primary phone number in E.164 format (e.g. "+14155551234").

company.description: Name of the company the customer belongs to.

externalId.description: Unique identifier from your own system (e.g. your CRM or database ID). Used to link this Kustomer record back to your data.

username.description: The customer's username in your system.

birthdayAt.description: Customer's birth date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z").

signedUpAt.description: When the customer registered, in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z").

avatarUrl.description: URL of the customer's profile image.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new customer record in Kustomer from identity and profile fields (name, email, phone, company, externalId, locale, etc.). Use to add a contact to Kustomer; pass externalId to link the record back to your own system. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate customer even with identical input, so guard against duplicates.

create-conversation.name: create-conversation
create-conversation.description: Creates a new conversation in Kustomer.

customer.description: The Kustomer ID of the customer this conversation belongs to. You can get this from the "Get Customer" action or from the URL when viewing a customer in Kustomer.

name.description: A short subject or title for the conversation (max 256 characters).

status.description: The initial status of the conversation.

direction.description: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.

externalId.description: A unique identifier from your own system to link this conversation (max 256 characters).

replyChannel.description: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat"). Leave empty to use the workspace default.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new conversation in Kustomer attached to an existing customer. Use to open a support thread for a known customer; the customer ID is required (resolve it first via Get Customer). Optional status, priority, direction, and reply channel set the conversation's initial state. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate conversation.

update-conversation.name: update-conversation
update-conversation.description: Updates an existing conversation in Kustomer.

conversationId.description: The Kustomer ID of the conversation to update. You can get this from the "Create Conversation" action output or from the URL when viewing a conversation in Kustomer.

status.description: Change the status of the conversation.

name.description: Update the subject or title of the conversation.

direction.description: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.

replyChannel.description: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat").

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Kustomer conversation identified by its conversation ID, changing fields such as status (open/done/snoozed), priority, name, direction, or reply channel. Only the fields you supply are modified. Use to change the state of a known conversation. Idempotent — repeating the same update yields the same end state.

get-customer.name: get-customer
get-customer.description: Gets a customer by ID from Kustomer.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Kustomer customer record by its Kustomer customer ID. Use to look up a customer's details when you already have their ID. Read-only and idempotent. The customer ID is required.

get-custom-objects.name: get-custom-objects
get-custom-objects.description: Retrieves all custom objects (KObjects) for a given class in Kustomer.

klassName.description: The API name of the custom object class to fetch (e.g. "order", "ticket"). You can find this in Kustomer under Settings > Custom Objects — it is the lowercase identifier, not the display label.

fromDate.description: Only return objects created or updated on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"). Leave empty to return all objects.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the custom objects (KObjects) of a given class in Kustomer, identified by the class's API name (the lowercase identifier, not the display label). Optionally pass a from-date to return only objects created or updated on or after it; leave it empty to return all objects of the class. Use to read or enumerate custom-object records. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

Authenticate using a Kustomer API token.

Paste a private Kustomer API token with access to customers, conversations, and KObjects.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

nl.Create and manage Kustomer customers, co: Maken en beheren van klanten van Kustomer, gesprekken en aangepaste objecten.
Authenticeer met behulp van een Kustomer API-token.

Plak een privé Kustomer API-sleutel met toegang tot klanten, conversaties en KObjects.
nl.Creates a new customer record in Kustome: Maakt een nieuw klantrecord in Kustomer.
Maakt een nieuw gesprek in Kostomer.
nl.Updates an existing conversation in Kust: Werkt een bestaand gesprek bij in Kustomer.
Haalt een klant op via ID van Kustomer.
nl.Retrieves all custom objects (KObjects): Haalt alle aangepaste objecten (KObjects) op voor een bepaalde klasse in Kustomer.
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.The customer's full name (e.g. \"Jane Do: De volledige naam van de klant (bijv. "Jane Doe").
nl.Name of the company the customer belongs: Naam van het bedrijf waartoe de klant behoort.
nl.Unique identifier from your own system (: Unieke identificatie uit uw eigen systeem (bijvoorbeeld uw CRM of database ID). Gebruikt om dit Kustomer record terug te koppelen aan uw gegevens.
De gebruikersnaam van de klant in uw systeem.
nl.Customer's birth date in ISO 8601 format: De geboortedatum van de klant in ISO 8601 formaat (bijv. "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z").
nl.When the customer registered, in ISO 860: Wanneer de klant is geregistreerd, in ISO 8601 formaat (bijv. "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z").
URL van de profielafbeelding van de klant
nl.The Kustomer ID of the customer this con: De Koestomer-ID van de klant waartoe dit gesprek behoort. U kunt dit krijgen van de "Neem klant" actie of van de URL tijdens het bekijken van een klant in Kustomer.
nl.A short subject or title for the convers: Een kort onderwerp of titel van het gesprek (max 256 karakters).
De initiële status van het gesprek.
nl.\"Inbound\" means the customer initiated: "Binnen" betekent dat de klant het gesprek heeft geïnitieerd; "Buiten" betekent dat je team het heeft geïnitieerd.
nl.A unique identifier from your own system: Een unieke id uit je eigen systeem om dit gesprek te koppelen (max 256 tekens).
nl.The channel used to reply in this conver: Het kanaal dat wordt gebruikt om in dit gesprek te beantwoorden (bijvoorbeeld "email", "chat"). Laat leeg om de standaard werkruimte te gebruiken.
nl.The Kustomer ID of the conversation to u: De Koestomer-ID van het gesprek om bij te werken. U kunt dit krijgen van de "Nieuwe conversatie" actie uitvoer of van de URL tijdens het bekijken van een gesprek in Kustomer.
Verander de status van het gesprek.
nl.Update the subject or title of the conve: Het onderwerp of de titel van het gesprek bijwerken.
nl.The channel used to reply in this conver: Het kanaal dat wordt gebruikt om in dit gesprek te reageren (bijvoorbeeld "email", "chat").
nl.The API name of the custom object class: De API naam van de aangepaste objectklasse om op te halen (bijv. "bestelling", "ticket"). U kunt dit vinden in Kustomer onder Instellingen > Aangepaste objecten - het is de kleine letter identificatie, niet het weergavelabel.
nl.Only return objects created or updated o: Retourneer alleen objecten die zijn aangemaakt of bijgewerkt op of na deze datum. Gebruik ISO 8601 formaat (bijv. "2024-01-15T00:00.00.000Z"). Laat leeg om alle objecten terug te geven.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.
nl.HEAD: HOOFD

Numéro de téléphone principal au format E.164 (par exemple "+14155551234").

fr.\"Inbound\" means the customer initiated: « À l'intérieur » signifie que le client a initié la conversation; « À l'extérieur » signifie que votre équipe l'a initiée.

fr.The channel used to reply in this conver: Le canal utilisé pour répondre à cette conversation (par exemple "email", "chat"). Laissez vide pour utiliser l'espace de travail par défaut.

es.No Error on Failure: No hay ningún error en fallo
es.The customer's full name (e.g. \"Jane Do: Nombre completo del cliente (por ejemplo, "Jane Doe").
Dirección de correo electrónico principal del cliente.
Número de teléfono principal en formato E.164 (por ejemplo, "+14155551234").
es.Name of the company the customer belongs: Nombre de la empresa a la que pertenece el cliente.

es.Language/locale code for the customer (e: Código de idioma/idioma para el cliente (por ejemplo, "es_US", "fr_FR", "de_DE").

El estado inicial de la conversación.
es.Conversation priority from 1 (lowest) to: Prioridad de conversación de 1 (más bajo) a 5 (más alto).
es.\"Inbound\" means the customer initiated: "Inbound" significa que el cliente inició la conversación; "Outbound" significa que su equipo la ha iniciado.

es.The channel used to reply in this conver: El canal utilizado para responder en esta conversación (por ejemplo, "email", "chat"). Dejar en blanco para usar el espacio de trabajo por defecto.
es.The Kustomer ID of the conversation to u: El ID de Kustomer de la conversación a actualizar. Puede obtenerlo desde la salida de la acción "Crear conversación" o desde la URL cuando vea una conversación en Kustomer.
Cambiar el estado de la conversación.
es.Update the subject or title of the conve: Actualizar el asunto o el título de la conversación.
es.The channel used to reply in this conver: El canal utilizado para responder en esta conversación (por ejemplo, "email", "chat").
es.The API name of the custom object class: El nombre de la API de la clase de objeto personalizada a buscar (por ejemplo, "order", "ticket"). Puede encontrar esto en Kustomer en Ajustes > Objetos Personalizados — es el identificador en minúsculas, no la etiqueta de visualización.
es.Only return objects created or updated o: Devuelve sólo objetos creados o actualizados en o después de esta fecha. Utilice el formato ISO 8601 (por ejemplo, "2024-01-15T00:00:00:00.000Z"). Deje en blanco para devolver todos los objetos.
es.Authorization headers are injected autom: Las cabeceras de autorización se inyectan automáticamente desde tu conexión.

zh.The Kustomer ID of the conversation to u: The Kustomer ID of the conversation to update. You can get this from the "Create Conversation" action output or from the URL when viewing a conversation in Kustomer.

zh.Update the subject or title of the conve: Update the subject or title of the conversation.
zh.The channel used to reply in this conver: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat").
zh.The API name of the custom object class: The API name of the custom object class to fetch (e.g. "order", "ticket"). You can find this in Kustomer under Settings > Custom Objects — it is the lowercase identifier, not the display label.
zh.Only return objects created or updated o: Only return objects created or updated on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"). Leave empty to return all objects.

pt.Create and manage Kustomer customers, co: Crie e gerencie clientes, conversas e objetos personalizados do Kustomer.
Authenticate using a Kustomer API token.

Paste a private Kustomer API token with access to customers, conversations, and KObjects.
pt.Creates a new customer record in Kustome: Cria um novo registro de cliente no Kustomer.
Cria uma nova conversa no Kustomer.
pt.Updates an existing conversation in Kust: Atualiza uma conversa existente no Kustomer.
Obtém um cliente por ID do Kustomer.
pt.Retrieves all custom objects (KObjects): Recupera todos os objetos personalizados (KObjects) para uma determinada classe no Kustomer.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.The customer's full name (e.g. \"Jane Do: Nome completo do cliente (ex: "A Jane Doe").
Endereço de e-mail principal do cliente.
Número de telefone primário no formato E.164 (por exemplo, "+14155551234").
pt.Name of the company the customer belongs: Nome da empresa a que o cliente pertence.
pt.Unique identifier from your own system (: Identificador exclusivo de seu próprio sistema (por exemplo, seu CRM ou ID do banco de dados). Usado para vincular este registro do Kustomer de volta aos seus dados.
O nome do cliente no seu sistema.
pt.Language/locale code for the customer (e: Código de idioma/local para o cliente (por exemplo, "en_US", "fr_FR", "de_DE").
pt.Customer's birth date in ISO 8601 format: Data de nascimento do cliente em formato ISO 8601 (por exemplo, "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z").
pt.When the customer registered, in ISO 860: Quando o cliente se registrou, no formato ISO 8601 (por exemplo, "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z").
URL da imagem do perfil do cliente.
pt.The Kustomer ID of the customer this con: O ID Kustomer do cliente a que essa conversa pertence. Você pode obter isso através da ação "Obter Cliente" ou através da URL ao visualizar um cliente no Kustomer.
pt.A short subject or title for the convers: Um breve assunto ou título para a conversa (máximo de 256 caracteres).
pt.Conversation priority from 1 (lowest) to: Prioridade da conversa de 1 (mais baixa) para 5 (mais alta).
pt.\"Inbound\" means the customer initiated: "Entrada" significa que o cliente iniciou a conversa; "Outbound" significa que a sua equipe o iniciou.
pt.A unique identifier from your own system: Um identificador exclusivo do seu próprio sistema para vincular esta conversa (máximo de 256 caracteres).
pt.The channel used to reply in this conver: O canal usado para responder nesta conversa (por exemplo, "email", "chat"). Deixe em branco para usar o padrão da área de trabalho.
pt.The Kustomer ID of the conversation to u: A ID Kustomer da conversa a ser atualizada. Você pode obter isso a partir da ação "Criar Conversação" ou a partir do URL ao visualizar uma conversa no Kustomer.
pt.Update the subject or title of the conve: Atualize o assunto ou o título da conversa.
pt.The channel used to reply in this conver: O canal usado para responder nesta conversa (por exemplo, "email", "chat").
O ID de cliente do Kustomer.
pt.The API name of the custom object class: O nome da API da classe de objeto personalizada a ser obtida (por exemplo, "ordem", "ticket"). Você pode encontrar isso no Kustomer em Configurações > Objetos personalizados — é o identificador minúsculo, não o rótulo de exibição.
pt.Only return objects created or updated o: Somente objetos de devolução criados ou atualizados a partir desta data. Use o formato ISO 8601 (ex: "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"). Deixe em branco para retornar todos os objetos.
